map.本地按行流式解析并聚合计数，内存占用低；建议先按时间窗或类型过滤再统计，超大数据: Parsed line by line locally with streaming aggregation, so memory usage is low; filter by time window or type before counting, and import very large data in segments.

map.：按时间轴统计事件频次找突发峰值；按 source IP 聚合计数找高频来源；按: : Count event frequencies along the timeline to find bursts; aggregate counts by source IP to find high-frequency sources; classify by event type (login failure / port scan / permission denied) to find the main risks; and stack conditions such as "the same IP has 10 or more failed logins within 5 minutes" to identify brute force attempts.
map.：解析 1 万行日志，发现 IP 203.0.113.7 在 10 分钟内产生: : Parsing 10,000 log lines found that IP 203.0.113.7 produced 240 failed logins within 10 minutes (concentrated on port 22), identified as an SSH brute force; another IP 10.0.0.9 triggered 56 permission denials, suspected privilege escalation probing, so blocking it or reviewing the whitelist is recommended.
